snippet.title: Snow Patrol - Chasing Cars - My Guitar Skill Check - Using Gibson Learn and Play App -
snippet.description:
Song: Chasing Cars
Band: Snow Patrol
My guitar lesson performance 
My Skill test and score 
Using the super cool 
Gibson App by Zoundio
Available Apple IOS, MAC and Android

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/gibson-learn-play-guitar/id1116032929

Gibson app has pitch detection 
Easy to follow scrolling tab 
A Superior Education system
Beginner friendly 
And intermediate 
Level Guitar lessons
With awesome 
Videos from Instructors 

App listens to
Your guitar with 
Phone or Tablet or Mac 
Excellent instructions 
Excellent arrangements 
Learning guitar 

There are many ways 
To use Gibson app

I connected my Stranberg Boden Essential 
To IPad Pro
With IRig HD 2
From IK Multimedia 
I used wired headphones 
I used in app standard amp

You can also simply 
Use device
Microphone 

IRig link
https://a.co/d/f6K47kl

Sometimes I use the 
Bias FX 2 App
For IPad 
For different Guitar Tones

Gibson app also has 
Built in Guitar tones
Easy and intermediate level

I Screen recorded my
Skill check Guitar Performance 
Easily As a video
With IPad 

I Edited video with
iMovie 

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/imovie/id377298193

Questions?

You can Join two
Facebook groups 

Gibson App Fan Club

https://m.facebook.com/groups/1921178304974675/?ref=share

Meet other beginners
We share all the ways
You can connect guitar

And 

Facebook group 
MiamiChristine Guitar 

https://m.facebook.com/groups/956150423024743/?ref=share

I am not affiliated with 
Gibson App
I am simply a super fan of the app

I am a guitar hobbyist 
Retired and living  in
The golden age of
Guitar gear and 
Learning tools

Groups help you find friends
To share your beginner guitar journey
Facebook user group
That can help you navigate
The Gibson App

#gibsonguitarapp
#learnguitar

#zoundioguitarapp
